architectural_decisions.rationale: This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript was chosen over JavaScript because it is the default language for NestJS and because its static typing allows for error detection at compile time.
AWS was chosen over other cloud services due to its low price and its prior use by the company.
This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform, increasing system security by reducing entry points to the outside.
The API Gateway pattern provides the ability to handle partial system failures, managing which services are running at all times.
Amazon Athena is a serverless service, which means it is not necessary to manage the infrastructure when there is an increase in the data set and users.
To obtain data quickly, Athena performs queries in parallel.
The physical architecture is divided into several different services to improve the security, scalability, and availability of the system.
Data is stored in subfolders depending on the date, client, and/or user, making data reading more efficient.
Kinesis Data Streams is used to transmit playlog and audit trail data to ensure the fastest possible data transmission in near real-time.
